claims.title: Taíno settle Borikén
claims.summary: Arawak-speaking peoples develop the Taíno culture on the island they call Borikén, living in cacique-led villages and farming cassava and other tropical crops.

claims.summary: Rebels seize Lares and proclaim a Republic of Puerto Rico; though crushed, the uprising becomes the foundational moment of the island's independence movement.
